parameters.content:
## Find forgotten subscriptions in your bank statement with Gemini and Google Sheets

### How it works
The average person pays for several subscriptions they forgot about. Upload a few months of statements as CSV and a Code node groups the transactions by merchant and finds the genuinely repeating ones - charged at least twice with a stable amount - so only aggregated candidates, never raw transactions, are sent to the AI. A Basic LLM Chain with Google Gemini then works out what each merchant actually is, its category, the monthly and annual cost, and whether to keep, review or cancel it, protecting essentials like rent, utilities and insurance. Each subscription is upserted into Google Sheets by merchant so repeat audits update rows instead of duplicating, and you get an email with the cancel list and the savings on the table.

### Setup
1. Connect Google Gemini (PaLM) API, Google Sheets and Gmail.
2. Point the Sheets node at your spreadsheet (tab: Subscriptions).
3. Export 3-12 months of statements as CSV with Date, Description and Amount columns.

### Customization tips
Tighten the repeat detection, or add a monthly scheduled re-audit.

## 1. Upload & detect repeats
A Code node groups transactions by merchant and keeps only charges that repeat with a stable amount. Statements with no repeats stop here with a helpful email.

## 2. AI classification (Basic LLM Chain)
Gemini names the real service behind each merchant string, prices it annually and recommends keep, review or cancel - protecting essentials.

## 3. Email the cancel list
Send the totals, the potential savings and exactly what to cancel or review.

## 4. Save one row per subscription
Split the list and upsert by merchant so you build a tracker you can sort by annual cost.
